notes: Direct fetch works (Cloudflare/Laravel+Vue SPA, no WAF block). Homepage/nav routes render client-side so raw curl HTML is a shell; used r.jina.ai rendered fetches to read actual nav (found in markdown as [text](url) links) and category grids. Site is Havenly-owned (footer lists Havenly, Interior Define, The Citizenry, St. Frank, Burrow as sibling brands) and is overwhelmingly a made-to-order upholstered-furniture and textiles business: Beds, Chairs, Sofas, Ottomans, Headboards, Benches, Desk Chairs, Curtains, Table Linens, Throw Pillows, Throw Blankets, Rugs, Wallpaper, Bedding, Fabric by the Yard, Outdoor furniture/pillows/rugs -- all out of scope per the brief (furniture, textiles, wallpaper). Full nav category tree confirmed via the app.js bundle's hardcoded '/c/...' and 'collections/...' route lists: zero routes for mirrors, clocks, vases, glassware, wall art, or any other in-scope decor type (grepped app.js for mirror/clock/vase/candle/glassware/decorative -- no hits at all). The ONE in-scope line found: 'Lighting' is a genuine standalone nav item (https://www.theinside.com/collections/lighting, page title 'Shop Lighting') selling table lamps, floor lamps, pendants, sconces, and picture lights -- kept as a single leaf row since the page opens directly onto a flat product grid with no sub-category nodes (only a 'Sort By' control, no filter-driven sub-URLs). The 'Decor' nav item (collections/decor) was inspected and dropped: it is a mixed marketing roll-up dominated by throw pillows/curtains/table linens/throw blankets (textiles) with a couple of lighting SKUs spilling in as duplicates of the Lighting collection -- a mixed roll-up per the 'drop them, don't pad' rule, not a distinct category. The site's sitemap-lighting.xml (stale, all lastmod 2023-03-16) lists product URLs that mostly now 301-redirect to the homepage (delisted SKUs), confirming the sitemap is outdated; the live collections/lighting page was used instead as the current source of truth. sitemap-frames.xml is bed/headboard SIZE-VARIANT URLs (furniture), not picture frames -- out of scope, not a mirror/wall-decor category. Qty verification: enumerated unique /products/ URLs on the rendered collections/lighting page across 3 independent r.jina.ai fetches (including one with a ?page=2 param) -- all three returned exactly the same 33 unique product URLs, no pagination controls, 'Load More' element, or count text present anywhere on the page or in app.js (no per_page/loadMore/totalCount tokens found), so 33 is treated as the full/exhaustive listing.
